response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile full-stack/systems engineer with deep technical craftsmanship across many languages and platforms, but his background shows no direct experience with experimentation systems, A/B testing platforms, feature flagging, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or growth engineering. His career has been largely generalist and product/infra focused rather than specialized in the measurement/experimentation domain this role requires, and there's no evidence of the cross-team platform leadership at enterprise scale or statistical/experimentation rigor the role demands.
strengths: Extensive full-stack and systems engineering experience across many languages (C, C++, C#, Java, JS/TS, DLang)
Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, and community building (workshops, talks, open-source projects)
Experience with distributed, high-throughput systems (Dunnhumby handling millions of requests/sec)
concerns: No demonstrated experience with experimentation platforms, feature flagging, or A/B testing infrastructure
No evidence of growth engineering, telemetry/metrics systems, or data-driven experimentation analysis
Career trajectory is broad/generalist rather than showing Principal-level ownership of large-scale, cross-team platform initiatives

key_factors.factor: No telemetry/metrics infrastructure or statistical analysis background
Strong general engineering depth and leadership/mentoring track record
